The '''Marzoon sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the southwestern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered [[Tashtor sector|Tashtor]], [[Semagi sector/Legends|Semagi]] and [[Dononter sector/Legends|Dononter sectors]] in the Mid Rim, as well as the [[Jidlor Marches/Legends|Jidlor Marches]] and free-standing trailing subsectors.<ref name="EAOC" />
